subject: Data Engineering
title: Query Optimization Basics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Query Optimization Basics.

hook.text: A query that takes 30 minutes can often be rewritten to finish in 30 seconds. The data hasn't changed.

buildup.text: Common wins: avoid SELECT *, filter early, use partition pruning, and limit expensive joins.

discovery.text: The EXPLAIN plan shows exactly how the warehouse executes your query — reads, joins, sorts, costs.

twist.text: The fastest query is the one that reads the least data. Reducing scan volume beats hardware every time.

climax.text: Query optimization is a skill that compounds. Small improvements across thousands of queries save fortunes.

punchline.text: Optimize the query before you scale the warehouse.

quiz.question: What is the fastest way to improve warehouse query performance?
options: Reduce the amount of data the query scans
Use longer column names for clarity
